symptom: ako/mxcli#721 L4: `describe page`/`describe snippet` -> exec rewrote every Studio Pro-authored pluggable widget (DataGrid2, combo box, filters, Image, Timeline, language selector) with run success and mx check green: Object properties re-ordered to the template's order, translated captions dropped, a row onClick OpenUserTaskClientAction replaced by NoAction, configurationStorageType localStorage -> attribute, onClickTrigger double -> single, and an Image's whole Type/ObjectType/PropertyTypes replaced by the template's. 37 page/snippet documents across PedApp and TestApp.
cause: PluggableWidgetEngine.Build always starts from the widget TEMPLATE (LoadWidgetTemplate) and the create-or-replace/modify page path never consulted the stored widget, so everything MDL does not map (and the stored schema version, order and markers) was reset. Second cause for byte-exactness: carryNoActionExecutionFrom set DisabledDuringExecution even when equal, which marks the NoAction dirty; inside a kept raw Object that made the encoder rebuild the lists with today's typed-array marker 3 where older Studio Pro stored 2.
insight: Keep the stored Type+Object when the statement's widget subtree equals the stored one as describe prints it (describe in the script's language, parse, declaredMatches) AND the rebuild names no entity/attribute/association the stored Object does not — the second guard catches a context change (enclosing data view re-pointed) that leaves the subtree text identical, and it is also what refused TaskInbox's grids, exposing a separate describe loss (column `Assoc/Attr` whose attribute lives on a specialization of the association's target, e.g. Administration.Account.FullName via WorkflowUserTask_Assignees, re-resolves to System.User.FullName). Any 'set' in a carry must be guarded by 'differs', or it dirties raw passthrough and re-encodes markers. Measure with a keyed diff (property matched by TypePointer -> PropertyKey); the harness's index diff made a pure reorder look like 1400 value changes.
